evidence.text: The inspected article discusses disputed readings in the Zhongshan king inscriptions but does not discuss the phrase 其隹能之. It therefore does not independently verify the bare-隹 reading. It cites specialist studies of the Zhongshan king tomb inscriptions, including publications from 1979 onward.

evidence.text: The page dates the Zhongshan king ding to the king's fourteenth year, approximately 314 BCE, and says it was excavated in 1977 from the Zhongshan royal tomb at Pingshan, Hebei. Its transcription reads 非信与忠，其谁能之. This supports the received-text reading 谁 in the inscription, but the transcription alone does not establish the original bronze graph's shape as 隹.

search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced the Palace Museum phrase 其隹(谁)能之 and Commons component files. Opened the seal-file descriptions and Fudan page; the Palace Museum PDF returned an internal error.

search_audit.query: 中山王鼎 非信与忠 其谁能之 隹 字形 考释 原铭 1979; 中山王鼎 铭文 其隹能之 释读 隹 誰 论文 古文字; site:humanum.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/Lexis/lexi-mf/search.php 誰 騅 金文 隹
search_audit.outcome: Opened the Wikisource transcription, which dates and locates the Zhongshan ding and transcribes the phrase with 谁. The Fudan article opened but does not address this phrase. The Palace Museum PDF remained inaccessible; its displayed search snippet is not treated as opened-page evidence.

search_audit.query: 中山王鼎 铭文 其隹能之 释读 隹 誰 论文 古文字; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 言-seal.svg 隹-seal.svg
search_audit.outcome: Opened the exact Commons description pages and inspected their direct-original-file links, script descriptions, and reuse notices. The precise original bronze shape behind the transcription's 谁 remains unverified by the opened inscription source.

gaps: The Palace Museum article's search snippet explicitly reads the bronze graph as 隹(谁), but the PDF could not be opened and the Fudan article inspected does not discuss that passage. The opened inscription transcription gives 谁 but not the graph's original shape; the bare-隹 reading therefore remains supported by the earlier CUHK dictionary report in the dossier, but was not independently confirmed from a newly opened inscription edition here.

Exact official Unicode kMandarin pages for 誰 (U+8AB0), 谁 (U+8C01), and 隹 (U+96B9) were not successfully inspected. The exact supplied local rows are recorded separately and should not be passed off as page-verified external data.

The exact Baxter–Sagart rows for both 誰 and 隹 were supplied locally and checked; no publicly accessible original table page with those exact rows was inspected. The local reading data support the same-system comparison only, not phonetic-role proof.
The local search hint for Shuowen Seal Radical 109 was not opened; the directly verified 隹-seal.svg asset is the selected suitable component illustration instead.

No exact 誰 bronze glyph image with verified image identity and license was found. The selected assets illustrate seal-script component forms only and do not visually substantiate the disputed bronze sequence.
